name: p10_deepcenter_best
title: Biohub P10 DeepCenter Best
purpose: One-factor P9 coupled-division A/B: select the DeepCenter best-validation checkpoint (epoch 2) instead of the last training snapshot (epoch 500). The checkpoint path and its fail-closed expected-epoch assertion move together as one scientific selector. Coupled divisions, harmonic association, detector weights, all gates and thresholds, ILP, relinking, gap closing, short-track policy, caps, datasets, and submission format remain exactly P9. No launch or submission is performed by this spec.

provenance.hypothesis: The observed public 0.926 and 0.923 lineages disagree on DeepCenter checkpoint selection. Test whether the early best-validation state is a better auxiliary gap-veto prior on the otherwise identical P9 surface.

artifact.verification: Kaggle dataset file listing, downloaded manifests, file SHA-256, and direct CPU torch.load inspection all agreed on 2026-08-24.

provenance.routes_on: a globally fixed checkpoint selector only; no dataset, crop, acquisition, hidden label, graph statistic, or image-content routing
provenance.interaction_warning: DeepCenter safe-division veto remains disabled, but its gap veto remains enabled; this A/B can therefore alter synthetic gap acceptance. Epoch 2 has the best recorded validation loss while epoch 500 is the exact later training state, but validation loss is not the competition metric.
